# System calls

*Generated by `tools/syscalls_doc.py` from the docstrings in `hpuxemu/emu.py`; do not edit by hand.*

HP-UX programs enter the kernel through the gateway page: `ldil L%0xc0000000,r1; ble 4(sr7,r1)`
with the call number in r22 (loaded in the delay slot), the first four arguments in
r26-r23 and the rest at -52(sp), -56(sp) ...; the result comes back in r28 (r29 for a
second value), r22 = 0 on success and 1 on failure with the errno in r28, and execution
resumes at r31. The emulator dispatches the number to `Process.sys_<name>` with the name
`sys/syscall.h` gives it ([ABI.md](ABI.md) has the conventions and structures).

**203 handlers** (169 real, 34 accept-and-ignore stubs) cover **198 of the 356 numbers** of
HP-UX 10.20's `syscall.h`; the remaining 158 are listed at the end. A handler marked *stub*
returns a constant or an error without doing anything.

| 165 | `shmat` | `sys_shmat` | shmat(shmid, addr, flag): attached in the third quadrant (0x90000000 up) when no address is given; SHM_RDONLY honoured |
| 166 | `shmdt` | `sys_shmdt` | shmdt(addr) |
| 314 | `shmctl` | `sys_shmctl` | shmctl(shmid, cmd, buf): IPC_STAT (struct shmid_ds in HP-UX layout), IPC_SET (mode), IPC_RMID |
| 156 | `semget` | `sys_semget` | semget(key, nsems, flag) |
| 158 | `semop` | `sys_semop` | semop(semid, sops, nsops): struct sembuf has the same layout on the host; blocks on the host, interruptible |
| 312 | `semctl` | `sys_semctl` | semctl(semid, semnum, cmd, arg): the BSD command numbers mapped to the host's; GETALL/SETALL/IPC_STAT through buffers |
| 159 | `msgget` | `sys_msgget` | msgget(key, flag) |
| 161 | `msgsnd` | `sys_msgsnd` | msgsnd(msqid, msgp, size, flag): the 32-bit mtype becomes the host's long |
| 162 | `msgrcv` | `sys_msgrcv` | msgrcv(msqid, msgp, size, mtype, flag) |
| 313 | `msgctl` | `sys_msgctl` | msgctl(msqid, cmd, buf): IPC_STAT, IPC_SET (mode, qbytes), IPC_RMID |

## The process table

| number | HP-UX name | handler | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 239 | `pstat` | `sys_pstat` | pstat(request, buf, elemsize, elemcount, index): PSTAT_STATIC and PSTAT_DYNAMIC with plausible values, PSTAT_PROC for the process itself. 11.00's libc sets PSTAT64_INTF (0x80000000) in the request and wants the _PSTAT64 layouts (64-bit fields, also in 32-bit programs) |
| 268 | `getnumfds` | `sys_getnumfds` | getnumfds(): one more than the highest open descriptor (what callers loop up to) |
| 334 | `sysfs` | `sys_sysfs` | sysfs(GETFSIND, name) / (GETFSTYP, index, buf) / (GETNFSTYP): the file system types |
| 260 | `fss` | `sys_fss` *(stub)* | fss: used by dld.sl and libc at startup (a fair-share scheduler query); 0 |
| 143 | `sethostid` | `sys_sethostid` *(stub)* | sethostid(id): accepted and ignored |
| 142 | `gethostid` | `sys_gethostid` *(stub)* | gethostid(): a fixed id (0x2000000) |
| 149 | `get_sysinfo` | `sys_get_sysinfo` *(stub)* | get_sysinfo: EINVAL (an internal kernel interface) |
| 358 | `sysinfo` | `sys_sysinfo` | sysinfo(command, buf, count): the SVR4 strings (1 sysname, 2 hostname, 3 release, 4 version, 5 machine, 6 architecture, 7 serial, 8 provider, 9 domain); returns the length needed |
| 247 | `audswitch` | `sys_audswitch` *(stub)* | audswitch(flag): auditing is off; accepted |
| 246 | `audwrite` | `sys_audwrite` *(stub)* | audwrite(record): auditing is off, the record is dropped (passwd writes one) |
| 248 | `audctl` | `sys_audctl` *(stub)* | audctl: no audit system; EINVAL |
| 240 | `getaudid` | `sys_getaudid` *(stub)* | getaudid(): the audit id; 0 |
| 242 | `getaudproc` | `sys_getaudproc` *(stub)* | getaudproc(): auditing off for this process |
| 243 | `setaudproc` | `sys_setaudproc` *(stub)* | setaudproc(flag): accepted |
| 151 | `privgrp` | `sys_privgrp` *(stub)* | privgrp(cmd, buf): no privileged groups; EINVAL |
| 32 | `gtty` | `sys_gtty` | gtty(fd, buf): ioctl TIOCGETP |
| 31 | `stty` | `sys_stty` | stty(fd, buf): ioctl TIOCSETP |
| 343 | `sched_get_priority_min` | `sys_sched_get_priority_min` *(stub)* | sched_get_priority_min(policy): 0 |
| 342 | `sched_get_priority_max` | `sys_sched_get_priority_max` *(stub)* | sched_get_priority_max(policy): 31 |
| 153 | `plock` | `sys_plock` *(stub)* | plock(op): accepted and ignored (nothing to lock in memory) |
| 152 | `rtprio` | `sys_rtprio` *(stub)* | rtprio(pid, prio): accepted; no real-time priorities |
| 85 | `swapon` | `sys_swapon` *(stub)* | swapon(path, ...): EPERM |
| 315 | `mpctl` | `sys_mpctl` *(stub)* | mpctl(request, ...): one processor: every request answers 1 |

## Not implemented

These numbers of `syscall.h` have no handler: the emulator prints `unimplemented syscall`
and returns ENOSYS. Most are kernel administration, the kernel threads of 10.30 and
later, or networking not yet reached by the programs tried.
